chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Hashim al-Bajali, from Abu Khadeeja, who said:

I saw Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) sacrificing his camel with its left leg tied. Then he stood by the side of its right leg and said: 'In the Name of Allah, and Allah is the Greatest. O Allah, this is from You and for You. O Allah, accept it from me.' Then he made an incision in its throat (larynx), then removed the knife with his hand. So when it fell down, he cut the place of slaughter with his hand.
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended method and supplication for sacrificing a camel according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi highlights the Sunnah of Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) in performing the sacrifice, emphasizing the precision of physical actions such as tying the left leg and the specific method of severing the throat. It underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on following the Imam's practical example in ritual purity and slaughter, linking the act to divine acceptance through the recitation of 'Bismillah' and 'Allahu Akbar'.
